title: ר' יעקב ברי' דרב אחא
author: Heilprin source tradition; Warsaw digital witness

paragraphs: R. Yaakov, the son of Rav Aḥa, in the name of R. Neḥunyah of Bet Ḥavran, Jerusalem Talmud, Shekalim, chapter 1, halakhah 1. And R. Abba bar Hamnuna, in the name of R. Adda bar Aḥai, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter HaZorek Get, halakhah 3. He asked R. Avdimi of Ḥaifa (see R. Abbahu). He spoke to R. Abbahu (see his entry). Before him: R. Aḥa, the brother of R. Yose of Beraktei (see 1960). Il'a said: R. Yaakov bar Aḥa said in the name of our teacher. He said, 'R. Assi said,' Mo'ed Katan (27a); in שס״ח [provisionally the new Shas], 'Assa' is a scribal error. Ta'anit (27b), Zevaḥim (116b); and on folio 55b, 'Rav Ashi said' is a scribal error. In R. Hoshaya's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Sukkah, chapter 1. In Hamnuna's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Shabbat, end of the chapter HaZorek. He said, 'R. Zeira said,' Berakhot (23a). In R. Ze'eira's name; and R. Ḥizkiyah and R. Yasa, in R. Yoḥanan's name. In Ḥizkiyah's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Shabbat, chapter 1, halakhah 1. R. Ḥizkiyah, in his name. In the name of R. Ḥiyya bar Abba, Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, chapter 3, mishnah 5; Ḥinena Kartyahu, Jerusalem Talmud, Beitzah, chapter 1, halakhah 5 (see Ḥanna Kartigna'ah); in the name of Ḥama, father of R. Hoshaya. R. Ḥanina. R. Tavla. Ḥanan bar Ba, in Rav's name; and in R. Yoshiyah's name. R. Yehudah ben Pazi. He said, 'R. Yehoshua ben Levi said,' Mo'ed Katan (27a). In R. Yoḥanan's name, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Sheloshah She'akhlu, mishnah 2, and Jerusalem Talmud, Sukkah, chapter 1, halakhah 1; and R. Assi. In R. Yoḥanan's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Yevamot, chapter 1, halakhah 6, and chapter HaDar, halakhah 1; Jerusalem Talmud, Shabbat, chapter 1, halakhah 10. In R. Yonatan's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Ma'aser Sheni, chapter 3, halakhah 1; Jerusalem Talmud, Shabbat, chapter 1, halakhah 4. In R. Yose's name. R. Yose said to him, 'I remember that you and R. Yirmeyah spoke in Resh Lakish's name,' Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Af Al Pi, halakhah 5. In the name of R. Yose son of R. Ḥanina, Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, chapter 8, halakhah 7 as printed (the corresponding passage is 8:6:7). In the name of R. Yitzḥak bar Naḥman, Jerusalem Talmud, Yevamot, chapter 11. R. Kohen. R. Meyasha. R. Mana bar Ḥizkiyah. They said, 'Akavya asked R. Shimon ben Lakish.' The rabbis of Caesarea, in his name, Jerusalem Talmud, Shabbat, chapter 1, halakhah 4. R. Shemuel bar Yitzḥak asked him. R. Shemuel. In the name of Shemuel bar Abba. He said, 'R. Simlai said,' Mo'ed Katan (16, end of side b). And R. Shimon bar Abba, in R. Elazar's name, Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Ein Omedin, halakhah 3; and R. Shimon bar Abba, R. Yehoshua ben Levi [a compressed chain, with the relation left unstated]. In R. Yannai's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Kiddushin, chapter HaOmer, halakhah 14 as printed (the corresponding passage is 3:12:7). He said, 'Resh Lakish said,' Mo'ed Katan (27a). R. Tanḥum bar Ḥiyya of Kefar Akko, in his name.
